intro: Genesis means beginnings. It's the first book of the Bible, and it answers the biggest questions first: where the world came from, why things went wrong, and how God began to put them right.
It moves in two parts. Chapters one to eleven tell the story of everyone: creation, Adam and Eve, Noah's flood, and the tower of Babel.
Chapters twelve to fifty follow one family, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph, and God's promise that through them every nation on earth would be blessed.
Jewish and Christian tradition hold that Moses wrote it, more than three thousand years ago.
As you listen, watch for God's promises, and how he keeps them, even when people fail.
This is Genesis, from the King James Bible. Old words are explained on screen as we go.
